name: Wenatchee River (Leavenworth – Cashmere)
blurb: Leavenworth's summer river — tubes and SUPs in town, big-water rafting rapids below Dryden.

sections.notes: Mostly Class II. Boulder Bend (Class III, AW mile ~2.9) can be sneaked on the right. Wood collects along the left shore. Discover Pass required at Peshastin (WDFW). Leavenworth Waterfront Park is free (AW).

Launch BELOW Dryden Dam — the dam is a deadly hydraulic; anyone coming from upstream must use the river-right portage (Chelan PUD). Rodeo Hole (III+), Drunkard's Drop, Turkey Shoot, Snowblind and Granny's (III). Dryden is a WDFW access: Discover Pass or WDFW Vehicle Access Pass required. Cashmere Riverside Park fee status not confirmed.

timing.note: A reviewed speed/flow calibration has not been established. Access and guide information remain available.
